summary.text: Mike Marvin, a Legal Marijuana Now Party candidate who won the party's primary, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Nebraska to Pete Ricketts.
His campaign website stated that, citing worsening health, he could not put in the effort the race required, would remain on the ballot, and urged supporters to back Dan Osborn.

paragraphs.text: Marvin earned a high school diploma from Dominican High School. His career experience includes serving as executive director of the Nebraska Association of Public Employees, which Ballotpedia describes as a former role.
He received 2.2% of the vote to Pete Ricketts' 50.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
